description: LIVE status straight from the mobile network: lifecycle status, profile install state, last network (operator, country, MCC/MNC, 4G/5G), device model and IMEI, activation and last-usage dates, data used. Expensive — use for diagnosis ("no data", "is it installed?"), not routinely.
name: get_esim_live_status
title: Get live eSIM status (network query)
